final_assessment.observation: Independent equipment and beam findings are consistent: KLYS:LI29:11:AMPL recorded a near-zero amplitude update and later recovery, while several BPMs recorded a sustained beam disturbance. Both observations are corroborated, but asynchronous diagnostics and incomplete RF context do not establish that the RF excursion uniquely caused the beam disturbance.
supporting_evidence: KLYS:LI29:11:AMPL fell from a time-weighted baseline median of 69.1162109375 to 0.0244140625 at 1604277203201922048 ns and updated to 69.091796875 at 1604277208198788864 ns [T-37ec9e46fff8].

Sustained low charge began at 1604277200697686480 ns in BPMS:DMPH:502:TMIT, BPMS:DMPH:693:TMIT, and BPMS:LTUH:450:TMIT; the charge-validity analysis marked disturbance_detected=true and quality_adequate=true [T-2c31c73f97c7].
BPMS:LTUH:250:X had a sustained 42-sample excursion beginning at 1604277200689428941 ns [T-f507fbefd015].
The neighbor heuristic also identified KLYS:LI29:11:AMPL as suspicious [T-adc89116ae80].
conflicting_evidence: BPMS:LTUH:250:TMIT had no low-charge samples, so the charge disturbance was not uniform across all measured BPMs [T-2c31c73f97c7].

No other RF amplitude channel appeared in the neighbor heuristic's suspicious list, but 28 columns had unknown baselines; this negative result is limited evidence and does not prove other stations were normal [T-adc89116ae80].
Timing analysis found causal attribution was not established because RF observations are asynchronous and the documented 0–5 s reporting delay is approximate [T-095069d88481].
data_limitations: RF records are sparse: KLYS:LI29:11:AMPL had 20 finite updates and a 0.9724137931034482 no-update fraction; NaNs indicate no new update and leading values remain unknown [T-37ec9e46fff8].
No RF phase data are present, and no timestamp shift or calibrated per-event delay is available [T-095069d88481].
Low-charge BPM positions are invalid/sentinel-coded and cannot be interpreted as physical orbit values [T-f507fbefd015].
Neighboring station records may be missing or inactive, and column presence does not establish station completeness [T-adc89116ae80].
final_assessment.requested_next_check: Retrieve read-only RF phase and interlock/fault-status records for KLYS:LI29:11 across 1604277200689428941–1604277208198788864 ns, and compare them with pulse-synchronized charge data using original timestamps and no assumed fixed delay. This could change the assessment of whether the amplitude excursion represents a broader station fault associated with the beam disturbance.
